productProof.detail: Repository implementation plus narrow controlled fixtures prove deterministic current-frame actor/generation descriptor extraction, exact binding checks, association proof checks, duplicate/conflict rejection, requested-actor filtering, stateless fail-closed behavior, and zero spatial authority in descriptors.

productProofBoundary: P12 proves identity/generation registry behavior only. P10/DeterministicRenderObjectAnchor remains position authority, W3 remains renderer-source proof authority, and no real-WOF draw or Owner-visible behavior is claimed.
